title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented UMKC library environments for solo work, group sessions, and technology-supported research.

cards.entity_name: Miller Nichols Library Ground Floor Study Spaces
cards.title: Ground Floor Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · quiet conversation
cards.notes: Set up near the Marr Sound Archives when you need an individual table, chair, nearby vending, and wall outlets for a longer work block.
cards.short_summary: Individual tables with outlets on the library’s quiet-conversation floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC Libraries lists multiple individual study spaces with tables, chairs, vending machines, and wall outlets on Miller Nichols Library’s Ground Floor; open spaces are not reservable.
cards.access_notes: Open study spaces are not reservable; follow the quiet-conversation volume level.

cards.title: Study Room 108A
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · First Floor
cards.notes: Reserve this enclosed room for a small project meeting when a monitor, webcam, whiteboard, and device connections will keep everyone working together.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed six-person room with presentation and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 108A seats 1–6 and includes a large monitor/computer, webcam, table, chairs, whiteboard, and HDMI, USB-C, and wireless connections.
cards.access_notes: Located on the First Floor; library rooms may be reserved for up to two hours per group per day.

cards.entity_name: Miller Nichols Library Second Floor Silent Study
cards.title: Second Floor Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · silent-study floor
cards.notes: Bring headphones and choose a table near the rolling or wall-mounted whiteboards for independent work that needs a fully silent setting.
cards.short_summary: Silent individual study with tables and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC Libraries designates the Second Floor of Miller Nichols Library for silent study and provides wall-mounted whiteboards, rolling whiteboards, and tables.
cards.access_notes: No conversation, group study, or cell-phone talking is allowed in designated silent-study areas.

cards.title: Active Study Room
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · Second Floor
cards.notes: Use this named Second Floor destination when you want a study stop distinct from the surrounding silent floor; confirm current room availability before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named study-room destination on Miller Nichols Library’s silent-study floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC’s Miller Nichols Library floor plan lists an Active Study Room among the Second Floor destinations, whose volume level is designated silent study.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Second Floor; use the library floor plan and Service Desk for current wayfinding or availability help.

cards.title: Digital Collaboration Studio Common Area
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · Third Floor
cards.notes: Check in at the Studio desk, then use the drop-in common area for collaborative research with mobile furniture, monitors, and a digital whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: A drop-in collaboration area with flexible furniture and digital displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Collaboration Studio’s common area is available on a drop-in basis and includes mobile furniture, high-definition monitors, and a mobile digital whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: For UMKC faculty, staff, and students; check in on arrival. It is a quiet-conversation area and requires closed drink containers.

cards.title: Collaboration Room 310A
cards.subtitle: Digital Collaboration Studio · Third Floor
cards.notes: Book this small room for a focused group session and connect a laptop to the Vibe Board when a shared screen and video call tools are useful.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-person collaboration room with a Vibe Board.
cards.evidence_claim: Digital Collaboration Studio Room 310A seats up to four and has a laptop-connectable Vibe Board plus camera-and-speaker teleconferencing technology.
cards.access_notes: UMKC students, staff, and faculty may reserve it for up to two hours per group per day using UMKC credentials.

cards.title: Collaboration Room 310B
cards.subtitle: Digital Collaboration Studio · Third Floor
cards.notes: Reserve this quiet-conversation room for a four-person-or-smaller team, especially when your session needs a shared digital board and teleconferencing setup.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable, technology-equipped small-group room in the Studio.
cards.evidence_claim: Digital Collaboration Studio Room 310B seats up to four and is equipped with a laptop-connectable Vibe Board and camera-and-speaker teleconferencing technology.
cards.access_notes: UMKC students, staff, and faculty may reserve it for up to two hours per group per day using UMKC credentials.

cards.entity_name: Miller Nichols Library Fourth Floor Study Areas
cards.title: Fourth Floor Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Miller Nichols Library · regular conversation
cards.notes: Choose a table, soft seating, or a reservable group room on the renovated floor when you want nearby power and a setting suited to collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Renovated group-friendly study areas with flexible seating and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Fourth Floor has study areas, 304 student-study seats, technology-enabled rooms, nearby outlets, and reservable group rooms for 3–8 people.
cards.access_notes: Study spaces are open while the library is open; many rooms can be reserved up to one week ahead in two-hour blocks.

cards.entity_name: Health Sciences Library Silent Study Area
cards.title: Health Sciences Library Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Library · north end
cards.notes: Head to the north-end silent area for uninterrupted individual work, and keep calls, conversation, and group work outside the designated zone.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent area in UMKC’s Health Sciences Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC Libraries identifies the north end of the Health Sciences Library as a designated silent area; its floor plan also lists a Silent Study Area.
cards.access_notes: No conversation, group study, or cell-phone talking is allowed in designated silent-study areas.

cards.entity_name: Health Sciences Library Active Study Room
cards.title: Health Sciences Library Active Study Room
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Library · south end
cards.notes: Ask at the Service Desk before using this active-work option, which pairs two treadmill desks with a standing desk for a change of study posture.
cards.short_summary: An active-work study room with treadmill and standing desks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Library’s Active Study Room at the south end has two treadmill desks and one standing desk.
cards.access_notes: The library is open 24 hours daily with card access to the School of Medicine building; ask the Service Desk for room information.
